
### Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `PasswordGenerator-macOS.zip` |
| Windows 10/11 | `PasswordGenerator-Windows.zip` |
| Linux (x86-64) | `PasswordGenerator-Linux.tar.gz` |

The apps are not signed. On first launch:
- **macOS:** right-click the app → **Open** → **Open**
- **Windows:** **More info** → **Run anyway**

### Known issues

- macOS app: button labels are clipped. Cosmetic only, see #1.
